prevention (B) Disease modification prevention (C) Secondary prevention (D) Preventive maintenance
(E) Tertiary prevention (F) Primary prevention (G) Risk reduction prevention (H) Selective prevention (I)
Targeted prevention (J) Universal prevention
 A. Disease modification prevention
B. Preventive maintenance
C. Selective prevention
D. Universal prevention
E. Tertiary prevention
F. Primary prevention
G. Quaternary prevention
H. Targeted prevention
I. Secondary prevention
